name: Charged Armor, Lesser
body:
School conjuration (creation) [force]; Level bloodrager 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (diamond dust worth 25 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless), Reflex, see text; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You create a field of force around the target that protects them from damage. The subject gains DR 5/-. It ignores the first 5 points of damage each time it takes damage from a weapon. Once the spell has prevented a total of 5 points of damage per caster level (maximum 50), it is discharged and explodes with force. All creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a Reflex save or take 1d4 force damage per caster level (maximum 10d4).
